head.t: Evident Vascular receives US FDA clearance for high-fidelity AI-powered IVUS imaging platform
head.x: Evident Vascular has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of the Evident Vascular guidance system and Evident peripheral imaging catheters.

f.t: Evident Vascular receives US FDA clearance for high-fidelity AI-powered IVUS imaging platform
f.x: Evident Vascular has announced US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance of the Evident Vascular guidance system and Evident peripheral imaging catheters.
Buyer: Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. Value £51,000.
Buyer: UK Health Security Agency. Value £31,032.

Named on HealthTrust Europe LLP (HTE) acting on behalf of Mid South Essex NHS Foundation Trust's own supplier list for this framework as "Evident Europe GmbH – UK Branch", on lots Lot 1, Lot 5. 25 suppliers on the framework.
